# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      portainer        = "10.100.1.100"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
      documents     = "10.100.5.104"  # LXC 504 - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    100 = local.ip_registry.core.portainer
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # Must use LAN IP since container network isn't routable from local machine
  traefik_ip = local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs for CLI Usage
# =============================================================================

output "container_ips" {
  description = "All container IPs (10.100.x.x)"
  value       = local._all_container_ips
}

output "lan_ips" {
  description = "LAN IPs for dual-NIC services (192.168.1.x)"
  value       = local.lan_ips
}

output "ip_registry" {
  description = "Full IP registry organized by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}

output "network" {
  description = "Network configuration"
  value       = local.network
}

# =============================================================================
# n8n LXC - Workflow Automation
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 502
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Plus traefik-route module for self-service routing.
# =============================================================================

module "n8n" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  # Identity
  name         = "n8n"
  container_id = 502

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores          = 2
  memory         = 2048
  swap           = 1024
  rootfs_size    = 8
  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir = "${path.module}/deploy"

  # SSH
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Container options - unprivileged for security
  unprivileged = true
  template     = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox notes
  service_description = "Workflow automation platform"
  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://n8n.${var.domain_internal}/"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.213:5678/"
  }
  services = [
    { name = "n8n", port = 5678, info = "Web UI and API" }
  ]
  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Docker Deployment

**Compose file:** `/config/docker-compose.yml`
**Data volume:** `n8n_data`

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f n8n
```

**Restart n8n:**
```
cd /config && docker compose restart n8n
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=n8n` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["n8n", "automation"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "n8n_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.n8n.container_id
  container_ip   = module.n8n.ip_address
  container_name = "n8n"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-502"

    pre_backup_commands = [{
      name    = "SQLite backup"
      command = "cp /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data/database.sqlite /var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data/database.sqlite.backup"
      timeout = 60
    }]

    include_paths = ["/config", "/var/lib/docker/volumes/config_n8n_data/_data"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,n8n"
  }

  depends_on = [module.n8n]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "n8n_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "n8n"
  backend_url = "http://${module.n8n.ip_address}:5678"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "n8n.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.n8n]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.n8n.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.n8n.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.n8n.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.n8n_route.internal_url
    direct   = "http://${module.n8n.ip_address}:5678/"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.n8n_route.remote_config_path
}

# =============================================================================
# OpenWebUI LXC - AI Chat Interface with Ollama
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 501
# IP: 192.168.1.221
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Features AMD GPU passthrough for Ollama LLM acceleration.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 501
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 12
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 24576
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 64
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OpenWebUI Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "openwebui" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "openwebui"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged for security (with GPU passthrough)
  unprivileged = true
  enable_gpu   = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "OpenWebUI"
  service_description = "AI chat interface with Ollama backend (AMD GPU accelerated)"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://ai.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.221:3000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenWebUI", port = 3000, info = "AI chat interface" },
    { name = "Ollama", port = 11434, info = "LLM backend (ROCM GPU)" },
    { name = "Portainer Agent", port = 9001, info = "Container management agent" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## GPU Acceleration

AMD Radeon 890M passed through for Ollama LLM acceleration:
- `/dev/kfd`, `/dev/dri` devices
- ROCM backend

**Check GPU:**
```
docker exec ollama rocminfo
```

## Quick Commands

**View logs:**
```
cd /config && docker compose logs -f openwebui
cd /config && docker compose logs -f ollama
```

**List models:**
```
docker exec ollama ollama list
```

**Pull new model:**
```
docker exec ollama ollama pull llama3.2
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=openwebui` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["openwebui", "ai", "ollama", "llm"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "openwebui_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.openwebui.container_id
  container_ip   = module.openwebui.ip_address
  container_name = "openwebui"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "daily"
    retention = "7"
    namespace = "lxc-501"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database dump needed - SQLite file backup is sufficient

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2", "/root/.ollama/**"]  # Exclude 32GB of Ollama models

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,openwebui"
  }

  depends_on = [module.openwebui]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "openwebui_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "openwebui"
  backend_url = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal and public routes (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "ai.${var.domain_internal}"
  public_domain   = "ai.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  public_middlewares   = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.openwebui]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.openwebui.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.openwebui.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.openwebui.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    internal = module.openwebui_route.internal_url
    public   = module.openwebui_route.public_url
    direct   = "http://${module.openwebui.ip_address}:3000"
  }
}

output "traefik_config_path" {
  description = "Path to Traefik config on Traefik LXC"
  value       = module.openwebui_route.remote_config_path
}

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - OpenTelemetry + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
# IP: 192.168.1.229
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "OpenTelemetry-based monitoring stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana      = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus   = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma  = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy         = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_otel_grpc = "http://192.168.1.229:4317"
    direct_otel_http = "http://192.168.1.229:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenTelemetry Collector", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "OpenTelemetry HTTP", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## OpenTelemetry Endpoints

**OTLP gRPC:** 192.168.1.229:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** 192.168.1.229:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-otel \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server 192.168.1.229 \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View OTEL collector logs
docker logs -f otel-collector

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "prometheus", "grafana", "otel"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
    portainer_edge_id      = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_id
    portainer_edge_key     = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_key
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-500"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "otel_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      portainer        = "10.100.1.100"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
      documents     = "10.100.5.104"  # LXC 504 - Paperless-ngx + Stirling-PDF
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.223"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    100 = local.ip_registry.core.portainer
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
    504 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.documents
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # Must use LAN IP since container network isn't routable from local machine
  traefik_ip = local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# =============================================================================
# Outputs for CLI Usage
# =============================================================================

output "container_ips" {
  description = "All container IPs (10.100.x.x)"
  value       = local._all_container_ips
}

output "lan_ips" {
  description = "LAN IPs for dual-NIC services (192.168.1.x)"
  value       = local.lan_ips
}

output "ip_registry" {
  description = "Full IP registry organized by category"
  value       = local.ip_registry
}

output "network" {
  description = "Network configuration"
  value       = local.network
}

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - OpenTelemetry + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
# IP: 192.168.1.229
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "OpenTelemetry-based monitoring stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana      = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus   = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma  = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy         = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_otel_grpc = "http://192.168.1.229:4317"
    direct_otel_http = "http://192.168.1.229:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenTelemetry Collector", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "OpenTelemetry HTTP", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## OpenTelemetry Endpoints

**OTLP gRPC:** 192.168.1.229:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** 192.168.1.229:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-otel \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server 192.168.1.229 \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View OTEL collector logs
docker logs -f otel-collector

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "prometheus", "grafana", "otel"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
    portainer_edge_id      = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_id
    portainer_edge_key     = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_key
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-500"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "otel_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Monitoring LXC - OpenTelemetry + Prometheus + Grafana + Uptime Kuma + ntfy
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 500
#
# Uses the docker-lxc module - the gold standard pattern for Docker apps.
# Observability stack for metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 500
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 4
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 4096
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitoring Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "monitoring"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 1024

  rootfs_storage = "tank"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Monitoring"
  service_description = "OpenTelemetry-based monitoring stack with Prometheus, Grafana, and alerting"

  service_urls = {
    grafana      = "https://grafana.${var.domain_internal}"
    prometheus   = "https://prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"
    alertmanager = "https://alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"
    uptime_kuma  = "https://status.${var.domain_internal}"
    ntfy         = "https://ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"
    direct_otel_grpc = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4317"
    direct_otel_http = "http://${local.lan_ips.monitoring}:4318"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "OpenTelemetry Collector", port = 4317, info = "OTLP gRPC receiver" },
    { name = "OpenTelemetry HTTP", port = 4318, info = "OTLP HTTP receiver" },
    { name = "Prometheus", port = 9090, info = "Metrics storage and alerting" },
    { name = "Grafana", port = 3000, info = "Dashboards and visualization" },
    { name = "Alertmanager", port = 9093, info = "Alert routing" },
    { name = "Uptime Kuma", port = 3001, info = "HTTP monitoring and status page" },
    { name = "ntfy", port = 8080, info = "Push notifications" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## OpenTelemetry Endpoints

**OTLP gRPC:** 192.168.1.229:4317
**OTLP HTTP:** 192.168.1.229:4318

Configure Proxmox metrics server:
```bash
pvesh create /cluster/metrics/server \
  --id homelab-otel \
  --type opentelemetry \
  --server 192.168.1.229 \
  --port 4317 \
  --proto grpc
```

## Grafana

Default login: admin / (password in 1Password)

## ntfy Topics

- `homelab-alerts` - Prometheus alerts
- `homelab-status` - Uptime Kuma notifications

Subscribe via mobile app or web UI.

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View OTEL collector logs
docker logs -f otel-collector

# Reload Prometheus config
curl -X POST http://localhost:9090/-/reload

# Test ntfy notification
curl -d "Test notification" http://localhost:8080/homelab-alerts
```

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=monitoring` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["monitoring", "prometheus", "grafana", "otel"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "monitoring_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    grafana_admin_password = local.op.grafana_admin_password
    uptime_kuma_username   = local.op.uptime_kuma_username
    uptime_kuma_password   = local.op.uptime_kuma_password
    discord_webhook_url    = local.op.discord_webhook_url
    portainer_edge_id      = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_id
    portainer_edge_key     = local.portainer_edge["monitoring"].edge_key
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/monitoring.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "monitoring_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.monitoring_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.monitoring.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Routes - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "grafana_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "grafana"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3000"

  internal_domain = "grafana.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Traefik config

  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Middlewares
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "prometheus_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "prometheus"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9090"

  internal_domain = "prometheus.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "alertmanager_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "alertmanager"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:9093"

  internal_domain = "alertmanager.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "uptime_kuma_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "status"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:3001"

  internal_domain = "status.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

module "ntfy_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "ntfy"
  backend_url = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:8080"

  internal_domain = "ntfy.${var.domain_internal}"

  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "monitoring_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.monitoring.container_id
  container_ip   = module.monitoring.ip_address
  container_name = "monitoring"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-500"

    pre_backup_commands = []  # No database - config only

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,monitoring"
  }

  depends_on = [module.monitoring]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.monitoring.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.monitoring.ip_address
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.monitoring.ssh_command
}

output "otel_endpoints" {
  value = {
    grpc = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4317"
    http = "http://${module.monitoring.ip_address}:4318"
  }
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.internal_url
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.internal_url
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.internal_url
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.internal_url
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.internal_url
  }
}

output "traefik_config_paths" {
  description = "Paths to Traefik configs on Traefik LXC"
  value = {
    grafana      = module.grafana_route.remote_config_path
    prometheus   = module.prometheus_route.remote_config_path
    alertmanager = module.alertmanager_route.remote_config_path
    uptime_kuma  = module.uptime_kuma_route.remote_config_path
    ntfy         = module.ntfy_route.remote_config_path
  }
}

# Immich LXC - Photo & Video Management
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 304
# IP: 192.168.1.222
#
# Self-hosted photo and video management with ML features and GPU acceleration.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate combined .env file with Immich + Edge credentials
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: We generate a combined .env file here instead of using the docker-lxc
# module's portainer_edge_id/key because Immich needs additional env vars
# for database, uploads, etc. The module would overwrite these.

resource "local_sensitive_file" "immich_env" {
  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Immich Configuration
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu from 1Password
# DO NOT EDIT - changes will be overwritten
# https://immich.app/docs/install/environment-variables

# Paths - these match the LXC mount points from main.tf
UPLOAD_LOCATION=/photos
DB_DATA_LOCATION=/var/lib/postgresql/data

# Version - use 'release' for latest stable
IMMICH_VERSION=release

# Database credentials
DB_PASSWORD=qjIYvd2gOMh71CBpgA
DB_USERNAME=postgres
DB_DATABASE_NAME=immich

# Timezone
TZ=America/New_York

# OpenTelemetry - push metrics to monitoring stack
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://10.100.5.100:4318
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=immich
IMMICH_TELEMETRY_INCLUDE=all

# Portainer Edge Agent credentials (from 1Password: portainer-edge-immich)
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${local.portainer_edge["immich"].edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${local.portainer_edge["immich"].edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  type    = number
  default = 304
}

variable "cores" {
  type    = number
  default = 6
}

variable "memory" {
  type    = number
  default = 6144
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  type    = number
  default = 32
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Immich Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "immich" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "immich-docker"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for mobile app)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.photos.immich}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.immich}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = 2048

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Enable AMD GPU passthrough for ML acceleration and video transcoding
  enable_gpu = true

  # NOTE: We don't set portainer_edge_id/key here because this app generates
  # its own .env file that includes both Immich and Edge credentials.
  # Setting them here would cause the docker-lxc module to create a separate
  # .env that would overwrite our combined one.

  # Mount points for photos and cache
  # These are configured via SSH (null_resource.configure_mount_points) since
  # the API token doesn't have permission for bind mounts (requires root@pam)
  mount_points = [
    {
      slot   = 0
      path   = "/photos"
      volume = "/tank/photos"
    },
    {
      slot   = 1
      path   = "/cache"
      volume = "/tank/cache/immich"
    }
  ]

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Immich"
  service_description = "Self-hosted photo and video management with ML features"

  service_urls = {
    internal = "https://photos.${var.domain_internal}"
    public   = "https://photos.${var.domain_public}"
    direct   = "http://192.168.1.222:2283"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Immich Web", port = 2283, info = "Photo management UI" },

# Install Dependencies (rclone, immich-go, icloudpd) via Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "install_dependencies" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id        = var.container_id
    icloud_download_dir = var.icloud_download_dir
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Install immich-importer dependencies
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: immich-importer
        icloud_download_dir: ${var.icloud_download_dir}

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Install System Packages
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Update apt cache
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            update_cache: yes
            cache_valid_time: 3600

        - name: Install base packages
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - curl
              - unzip
              - cron
              - python3
            state: present

        # =====================================================================
        # Install uv (fast Python package manager)
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if uv is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which uv
          register: uv_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install uv
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          when: uv_check.rc != 0

        # =====================================================================
        # Install icloudpd (iCloud Photo Downloader)
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if icloudpd is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which icloudpd
          register: icloudpd_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false
          environment:
            PATH: "/root/.local/bin:{{ ansible_env.PATH }}"

        - name: Install icloudpd via uv
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: /root/.local/bin/uv tool install icloudpd
          when: icloudpd_check.rc != 0
          environment:
            PATH: "/root/.local/bin:{{ ansible_env.PATH }}"

        # =====================================================================
        # Install rclone
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if rclone is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which rclone
          register: rclone_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install rclone
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash
          when: rclone_check.rc != 0

        # =====================================================================
        # Install immich-go (latest release)
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if immich-go is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which immich-go
          register: immich_go_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Get latest immich-go version
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/simulot/immich-go/releases/latest | grep tag_name | cut -d'"' -f4
          register: immich_go_version
          when: immich_go_check.rc != 0

        - name: Download and install immich-go
          ansible.builtin.unarchive:
            src: "https://github.com/simulot/immich-go/releases/download/{{ immich_go_version.stdout }}/immich-go_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz"
            dest: /usr/local/bin
            remote_src: yes
            mode: '0755'
            include:
              - immich-go
          when: immich_go_check.rc != 0

        # =====================================================================
        - name: Create required directories
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: "{{ item }}"

            mode: '0755'
          loop:

            - /var/log

type = b2

key = ${var.b2_application_key}

password = ${var.rclone_crypt_password}
password2 = ${var.rclone_crypt_password2}

}

resource "local_sensitive_file" "icloud_env" {

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deploy Config Files via filesync
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "filesync_file" "rclone_conf" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.rclone_conf.filename
  destination = "/root/.config/rclone/rclone.conf"
  host        = local.ssh_host

  mode         = "0600"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_dependencies]
}

resource "filesync_file" "cloud_sync_script" {
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/cloud-sync.sh"
  destination = "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh"
  host        = local.ssh_host

  mode         = "0755"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_dependencies]
}

resource "filesync_file" "icloud_sync_script" {
  source      = "${path.module}/deploy/icloud-sync.sh"
  destination = "/usr/local/bin/icloud-sync.sh"
  host        = local.ssh_host

  mode         = "0755"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_dependencies]
}

resource "filesync_file" "icloud_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.icloud_env.filename
  destination = "/etc/profile.d/icloud-sync.sh"
  host        = local.ssh_host

  mode         = "0644"
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [ansible_navigator_run.install_dependencies]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configure Cron Jobs (Cloud Backup + iCloud Sync) via Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "configure_cron" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.cloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.icloud_sync_script,
    filesync_file.icloud_env,
    filesync_file.rclone_conf
  ]

  triggers = {
    container_id        = var.container_id
    cloud_schedule      = var.cloud_backup_schedule
    icloud_schedule     = var.icloud_sync_schedule
    icloud_sync_command = "sync-albums"  # Change this to trigger cron update
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Configure cron jobs for immich-importer
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: immich-importer
        cloud_schedule: "${var.cloud_backup_schedule}"
        icloud_schedule: "${var.icloud_sync_schedule}"

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Configure Cron Jobs
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Add cloud backup cron job (B2 sync)
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "Cloud backup to B2"
            minute: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos >> /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        - name: Add iCloud sync cron job
          ansible.builtin.cron:
            name: "iCloud photo sync"
            minute: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: ". /etc/profile.d/icloud-sync.sh && /usr/local/bin/icloud-sync.sh sync-albums >> /var/log/icloud-sync.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        # =====================================================================
        # Ensure Cron Service is Running
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Ensure cron service is enabled and running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: cron
            enabled: yes
            state: started

        - name: Display cron configuration
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg:
              - "Cron configured for {{ app_name }}"
              - "  Cloud backup: {{ cloud_schedule }}"
              - "  iCloud sync:  {{ icloud_schedule }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "immich-importer" = {
          ansible_host = local.ssh_host
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

output "container_id" {
  value = module.lxc.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = local.ssh_host
}

output "ssh_command" {
  value = "ssh root@${local.ssh_host}"
}

output "cloud_backup_schedule" {
  value = var.cloud_backup_schedule
}

output "icloud_sync_schedule" {
  value = var.icloud_sync_schedule
}

      tasks:

        - name: Update apt cache

        - name: Check if uv is installed

        - name: Check if rclone is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which rclone
          register: rclone_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install rclone
          ansible.builtin.shell:

            - /var/log

      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)

        # =====================================================================

            minute: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[0] }}"
            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"

            state: started

  source = "../../modules/lxc-base"

  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.immich_importer}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Ubuntu template (matches existing container)
  template = "local:vztmpl/ubuntu-24.04-standard_24.04-2_amd64.tar.zst"
  os_type  = "ubuntu"

  # Container features
  unprivileged   = true
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true

  ssh_public_key = local.ssh_public_key

## Services

- **immich-go**: Photo importer to Immich
- **rclone**: Cloud backup to B2 (encrypted)

```

icloud-sync.sh status    # Check sync status

```

```bash

```

cloud-sync.sh photos     # Sync to B2
```

```bash
immich-go -server ${local.immich_server} upload /downloads
```

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "install_dependencies" {
  depends_on = [module.lxc]

  triggers = {
    container_id        = var.container_id
    icloud_download_dir = var.icloud_download_dir
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Install immich-importer dependencies
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: immich-importer
        icloud_download_dir: ${var.icloud_download_dir}

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Install System Packages
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Update apt cache
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            update_cache: yes
            cache_valid_time: 3600

        - name: Install base packages
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - curl
              - unzip
              - cron
              - python3
            state: present

        # =====================================================================
        # Install uv (fast Python package manager)
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if uv is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which uv
          register: uv_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install uv
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
          when: uv_check.rc != 0

        # =====================================================================
        # Install icloudpd (iCloud Photo Downloader)
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if icloudpd is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which icloudpd
          register: icloudpd_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false
          environment:

        - name: Install icloudpd via uv
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: /root/.local/bin/uv tool install icloudpd
          when: icloudpd_check.rc != 0
          environment:
            PATH: "/root/.local/bin:{{ ansible_env.PATH }}"

        # =====================================================================
        # Install rclone
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if rclone is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which rclone
          register: rclone_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Install rclone
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | bash
          when: rclone_check.rc != 0

        # =====================================================================
        # Install immich-go (latest release)
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check if immich-go is installed
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: which immich-go
          register: immich_go_check
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Get latest immich-go version
          ansible.builtin.shell:
            cmd: curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/simulot/immich-go/releases/latest | grep tag_name | cut -d'"' -f4

            dest: /usr/local/bin
            remote_src: yes
            mode: '0755'
            include:
              - immich-go
          when: immich_go_check.rc != 0

        # =====================================================================
        # Create Required Directories
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Create required directories
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: "{{ item }}"
            state: directory
            mode: '0755'
          loop:
            - /root/.config/rclone
            - /root/.icloudpd
            - "{{ icloud_download_dir }}"
            - /var/log

        - name: Display installation status
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "Dependencies installed successfully for {{ app_name }}"
  EOT

            hour: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"
            month: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[3] }}"
            weekday: "{{ cloud_schedule.split()[4] }}"
            job: "/usr/local/bin/cloud-sync.sh photos >> /var/log/cloud-sync-photos.log 2>&1"
            user: root

        - name: Add iCloud sync cron job

            hour: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[1] }}"
            day: "{{ icloud_schedule.split()[2] }}"

              - "  iCloud sync:  {{ icloud_schedule }}"

variable "container_id" {

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "traefik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "traefik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (dual-NIC: container network + LAN for external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  lan_ip       = "${local.lan_ips.traefik}${local.network.lan_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # MUST be privileged for binding to ports 80/443
  unprivileged = false

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude migrated routes (managed by traefik-route module) and env templates (env is generated)
  exclude_patterns = ["^migrated-dynamic/", "^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = var.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Traefik"
  service_description = "Reverse proxy and ingress controller for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"
    direct             = "http://${local.traefik_ip}:8080/dashboard/"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "HTTP", port = 80, info = "HTTP entrypoint (redirects to HTTPS)" },
    { name = "HTTPS", port = 443, info = "HTTPS entrypoint with Let's Encrypt" },
    { name = "Metrics", port = 8082, info = "Prometheus metrics endpoint" },
    { name = "Portainer Edge Agent", port = 0, info = "Outbound tunnel to Portainer" }

  custom_notes = file("${path.module}/notes.md")

  tags = ["traefik", "ingress", "reverse-proxy"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "traefik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    cf_api_token       = local.op.cloudflare_api_token
    cf_api_email       = local.op.cloudflare_email

  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

    exclude_paths = ["/config/acme.json", "/config/logs/**"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,traefik"

  depends_on = [module.traefik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Outputs

output "container_id" {
  value = module.traefik.container_id
}

output "ip_address" {
  value = module.traefik.ip_address

output "ssh_command" {
  value = module.traefik.ssh_command
}

output "urls" {
  value = {
    dashboard_internal = "https://traefik.${var.domain_internal}/dashboard/"

## Tailscale Management

Tailscale runs as a systemd service (not Docker) because it requires kernel-level network access.

  # Re-run when container is rebuilt or network config changes
  triggers = {
    container_id = var.container_id
    lan_ip       = local.lan_ips.network_services
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host

    - name: Manage Tailscale service on network-services
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        app_name: network-services

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Tailscale Service Management
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Ensure Tailscale daemon is running
          ansible.builtin.systemd:
            name: tailscaled
            state: started
            enabled: true
          register: tailscale_service

        - name: Wait for Tailscale to initialize
          ansible.builtin.pause:
            seconds: 3
          when: tailscale_service.changed

        # =====================================================================
        # Verify Tailscale Status
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check Tailscale connection status
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: tailscale status --json
          register: tailscale_status
          changed_when: false
          failed_when: false

        - name: Parse Tailscale status
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            tailscale_info: "{{ tailscale_status.stdout | from_json }}"
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Display Tailscale connection info
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: |
              Tailscale Status: {{ 'Connected' if (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) == 'Running' else 'Not Connected' }}
              Tailnet IP: {{ tailscale_info.Self.TailscaleIPs[0] | default('N/A') }}
              Hostname: {{ tailscale_info.Self.HostName | default('N/A') }}
          when: tailscale_status.rc == 0

        - name: Warn if Tailscale not connected
          ansible.builtin.debug:
            msg: "WARNING: Tailscale is not connected. Check authentication status with 'tailscale status'"
          when: tailscale_status.rc != 0 or (tailscale_info.BackendState | default('')) != 'Running'
