services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.115.1
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.115.1
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:13133/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-monitoring
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:
  portainer_agent_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.115.1
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:13133/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting
  # ==========================================================================
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0
    container_name: prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'
      - '--storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d'
      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'
      - '--web.enable-remote-write-receiver'
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - ./prometheus/alerts:/etc/prometheus/alerts:ro
      - prometheus_data:/prometheus
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9090/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Alertmanager - Alert routing and notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  alertmanager:
    image: prom/alertmanager:v0.28.1
    container_name: alertmanager
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml'
      - '--storage.path=/alertmanager'
    ports:
      - "9093:9093"
    volumes:
      - ./alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:/etc/alertmanager/alertmanager.yml:ro
      - ./alertmanager/templates:/etc/alertmanager/templates:ro
      - alertmanager_data:/alertmanager
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:9093/-/healthy || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Grafana - Visualization and dashboards
  # ==========================================================================
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:11.4.0
    container_name: grafana
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER=admin
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      - GF_USERS_ALLOW_SIGN_UP=false
      - GF_SERVER_ROOT_URL=https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./grafana/provisioning:/etc/grafana/provisioning:ro
      - ./grafana/dashboards:/var/lib/grafana/dashboards:ro
      - grafana_data:/var/lib/grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3001 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-monitoring
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:
  portainer_agent_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Server with Ad Blocking
  # ==========================================================================
  # Primary DNS server for the network. Uses Cloudflare DNS as upstream.
  # Provides ad blocking, DNS filtering, and local DNS rewrites.
  adguard:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:v0.107.71
    container_name: adguard
    volumes:
      - ./adguard/work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./adguard/conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf
    ports:
      # DNS ports - bind to host IP for network-wide access
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      # Web UI (AdGuard listens on port 80 internally)
      - "3000:80/tcp"
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflared - Cloudflare Tunnel
  # ==========================================================================
  # Exposes internal services to the internet via Cloudflare Tunnel.
  # No inbound ports required - outbound-only connection to Cloudflare.
  cloudflared:
    image: cloudflare/cloudflared:2025.11.1
    container_name: cloudflared
    command: tunnel --no-autoupdate run
    environment:
      - TUNNEL_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN}
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Cloudflare DDNS - Dynamic DNS Updater
  # ==========================================================================
  # Updates Cloudflare DNS records with the current public IP.
  # Useful for services that need direct IP access.
  cloudflare-ddns:
    image: favonia/cloudflare-ddns:1.15.1
    container_name: cloudflare-ddns
    environment:
      - CF_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN}
      - DOMAINS=${CLOUDFLARE_DDNS_DOMAINS:-homelab.rambtech.dev}
      - PROXIED=false
      - IP6_PROVIDER=none
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-network-services
  portainer-edge-agent:
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  portainer_agent_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # AdGuard Home - DNS Server with Ad Blocking
  # ==========================================================================
  # Primary DNS server for the network. Uses Cloudflare DNS as upstream.
  # Provides ad blocking, DNS filtering, and local DNS rewrites.
  adguard:
    image: adguard/adguardhome:v0.107.71
    container_name: adguard
    volumes:
      - ./adguard/work:/opt/adguardhome/work
      - ./adguard/conf:/opt/adguardhome/conf
    ports:
      # DNS ports - bind to host IP for network-wide access
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      # Web UI (AdGuard listens on port 80 internally)
      - "3000:80/tcp"
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80 || exit 1"]

      timeout: 10s

      start_period: 10s

      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenWebUI - AI Chat Interface
  # ==========================================================================
  openwebui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:v0.6.41
    container_name: openwebui
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://ollama:11434
      - WEBUI_AUTH=true
      - WEBUI_NAME=Homelab AI
      - ENABLE_SIGNUP=false  # Security: Disable public signup
      - DEFAULT_MODELS=llama3.2:latest
    ports:
      - "3000:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./openwebui:/app/backend/data
    depends_on:
      - ollama
    # DNS settings for external resolution
    dns:
      - 8.8.8.8
      - 1.1.1.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Ollama - Local LLM Backend (AMD GPU Accelerated)
  # ==========================================================================
  ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:0.13.4-rocm
    container_name: ollama
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0
      - OLLAMA_ORIGINS=http://localhost,http://openwebui,https://ai.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.0.0
    ports:
      - "11434:11434"
    volumes:
      # Reuse existing Ollama data (32GB of models) from native install
      - /root/.ollama:/root/.ollama
    # AMD GPU passthrough via ROCM
    devices:
      - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    group_add:
      - video
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Secure container management
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-openwebui
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  portainer_agent_data:

**Verdict:** GOOD - Appropriate for homelab scale

- Best practice: memory requests = limits (you follow this with reservations)

**Verdict:** OVER-PROVISIONED - Could reduce to 1024-2048m safely

**Justification for Current Values:** If you're running many complex dashboards with heavy queries, the higher allocation provides headroom. However, monitoring actual usage would likely show 1-2GB is sufficient.

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenWebUI - AI Chat Interface
  # ==========================================================================
  openwebui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:v0.6.41
    container_name: openwebui
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://ollama:11434
      - WEBUI_AUTH=true
      - WEBUI_NAME=Homelab AI
      - ENABLE_SIGNUP=false  # Security: Disable public signup
      - DEFAULT_MODELS=llama3.2:latest
    ports:
      - "3000:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./openwebui:/app/backend/data
    depends_on:
      - ollama
    # DNS settings for external resolution
    dns:
      - 8.8.8.8
      - 1.1.1.1
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Ollama - Local LLM Backend (AMD GPU Accelerated)
  # ==========================================================================
  ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:0.13.4-rocm
    container_name: ollama
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0
      - OLLAMA_ORIGINS=http://localhost,http://openwebui,https://ai.homelab.rambtech.dev
      - HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.0.0
    ports:
      - "11434:11434"
    volumes:
      # Reuse existing Ollama data (32GB of models) from native install
      - /root/.ollama:/root/.ollama
    # AMD GPU passthrough via ROCM
    devices:
      - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    group_add:
      - video
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '4.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "ollama list || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Secure container management
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-openwebui
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1

      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

# Immich - Self-hosted photo and video management
# https://immich.app/docs/install/docker-compose
# Updated: 2025-12 based on official v1.123+ config

name: immich

services:
  immich-server:
    container_name: immich_server
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Hardware transcoding: VAAPI for AMD GPU
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    group_add:
      - video
    volumes:
      - ${UPLOAD_LOCATION}:/usr/src/app/upload
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    env_file:
      - .env
    ports:
      - 2283:2283
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - database
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '4.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  immich-machine-learning:
    container_name: immich_machine_learning
    # Using CPU image since AMD Radeon 890M (gfx1150) needs ROCm 6.4.4+
    # Immich ROCm image only has 6.3.4
    # Change to :release-rocm if/when Immich updates ROCm version
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Uncomment below and change image tag to :release-rocm when ROCm 6.4.4+ is available
    # devices:
    #   - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    #   - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    # group_add:
    #   - video
    #   - render
    volumes:
      - model-cache:/cache
    env_file:
      - .env
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '4.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  redis:
    container_name: immich_redis
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:8-bookworm
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: valkey-cli ping || exit 1
    restart: unless-stopped

  database:
    container_name: immich_postgres
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE_NAME}
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: '--data-checksums'
    volumes:
      - ${DB_DATA_LOCATION}:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: >-
        pg_isready --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}" || exit
        1; Chksum="$$(psql --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}"
        --tuples-only --no-align --command='SELECT COALESCE(SUM(googlechecksum(googlechecksum(tableoid,
        entity_id))), 0) FROM entity WHERE NOT is_external')"; Prev="$$(cat
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum 2>/dev/null || echo '')"; echo "$${Chksum}" >
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum; test "$${Prev}" = '' -o "$${Prev}" = "$${Chksum}"
      interval: 5m
      start_interval: 30s
      start_period: 5m
    command:
      [
        'postgres',
        '-c',
        'shared_preload_libraries=vchord.so,vectors.so',
        '-c',
        'search_path="$$user", public, vectors',
        '-c',
        'logging_collector=on',
        '-c',
        'max_wal_size=2GB',
        '-c',
        'shared_buffers=512MB',
        '-c',
        'wal_compression=on',
      ]
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-immich
  portainer-edge-agent:
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  model-cache:
  portainer_agent_data:

# Jellyfin Media Server Stack
# Includes: Jellyfin, Jellyseerr, Jellystat + PostgreSQL

name: jellyfin

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Streaming Server
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:10.11.5
    container_name: jellyfin
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - jellyfin-config:/config
      - jellyfin-cache:/cache
      - /data/library:/data/library:ro
    # AMD GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding (VA-API)
    group_add:
      - "44"   # video group for GPU access
      - "104"  # render group for GPU access
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
      - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '4.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8096/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyseerr - Media Request Management (Overseerr fork for Jellyfin)
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyseerr:
    image: fallenbagel/jellyseerr:2.7.3
    container_name: jellyseerr
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
    ports:
      - "5055:5055"
    volumes:
      - jellyseerr-config:/app/config
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:5055/api/v1/status || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellystat - Statistics and Analytics for Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat:
    image: cyfershepard/jellystat:1.1.6
    container_name: jellystat
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_IP=jellystat-db
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - JWT_SECRET=${JELLYSTAT_JWT_SECRET}
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - jellystat-data:/app/backend/backup-data
    depends_on:
      jellystat-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Jellystat
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat-db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: jellystat-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=jellystat
    volumes:
      - jellystat-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U jellystat"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================

      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:

          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:

  jellyseerr-config:
  jellystat-data:
  jellystat-pgdata:
  portainer_agent_data:

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.2
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      # Allow CSRF from both internal and public domains
      - PAPERLESS_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,docs.rambtech.dev,localhost
      - PAPERLESS_CORS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: paperless-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=paperless
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=paperless
    volumes:
      - paperless-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Redis - Cache/Broker for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-redis:
    image: redis:8.4-alpine
    container_name: paperless-redis
    volumes:
      - paperless-redis-data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Stirling-PDF - PDF Manipulation Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  # Comprehensive PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, etc.
  # Stateless service - no persistent data needed.
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:2.1.4
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    environment:
      - DOCKER_ENABLE_SECURITY=false
      - SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN=false
      - SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE=en_US
      - UI_APPNAME=Stirling PDF
      - UI_HOMEDESCRIPTION=PDF tools for the homelab
      - METRICS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Training data for better OCR (optional)
      - stirling-tessdata:/usr/share/tessdata
      # Custom configurations
      - stirling-configs:/configs
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8080/api/v1/info/status || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-documents
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  paperless-data:
  paperless-media:
  paperless-pgdata:
  paperless-redis-data:
  stirling-tessdata:
  stirling-configs:
  portainer_agent_data:

# Immich - Self-hosted photo and video management
# https://immich.app/docs/install/docker-compose
# Updated: 2025-12 based on official v1.123+ config

name: immich

services:
  immich-server:
    container_name: immich_server
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Hardware transcoding: VAAPI for AMD GPU
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    group_add:
      - video
    volumes:
      - ${UPLOAD_LOCATION}:/usr/src/app/upload
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
    env_file:
      - .env
    ports:
      - 2283:2283
    depends_on:
      - redis
      - database
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '4.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  immich-machine-learning:
    container_name: immich_machine_learning
    # Using CPU image since AMD Radeon 890M (gfx1150) needs ROCm 6.4.4+
    # Immich ROCm image only has 6.3.4
    # Change to :release-rocm if/when Immich updates ROCm version
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-machine-learning:${IMMICH_VERSION:-release}
    # Uncomment below and change image tag to :release-rocm when ROCm 6.4.4+ is available
    # devices:
    #   - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
    #   - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    # group_add:
    #   - video
    #   - render
    volumes:
      - model-cache:/cache
    env_file:
      - .env
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '4.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      disable: false

  redis:
    container_name: immich_redis
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:8-bookworm
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: valkey-cli ping || exit 1
    restart: unless-stopped

  database:
    container_name: immich_postgres
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.4.3-pgvectors0.2.0
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE_NAME}
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: '--data-checksums'
    volumes:
      - ${DB_DATA_LOCATION}:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: >-
        pg_isready --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}" || exit
        1; Chksum="$$(psql --dbname="$${POSTGRES_DB}" --username="$${POSTGRES_USER}"
        --tuples-only --no-align --command='SELECT COALESCE(SUM(googlechecksum(googlechecksum(tableoid,
        entity_id))), 0) FROM entity WHERE NOT is_external')"; Prev="$$(cat
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum 2>/dev/null || echo '')"; echo "$${Chksum}" >
        /tmp/.immich_db_checksum; test "$${Prev}" = '' -o "$${Prev}" = "$${Chksum}"
      interval: 5m
      start_interval: 30s
      start_period: 5m

# Jellyfin Media Server Stack
# Includes: Jellyfin, Jellyseerr, Jellystat + PostgreSQL

name: jellyfin

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyfin - Media Streaming Server
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:10.11.5
    container_name: jellyfin
    user: 1000:1000
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - jellyfin-config:/config
      - jellyfin-cache:/cache
      - /data/library:/data/library:ro
    # AMD GPU passthrough for hardware transcoding (VA-API)
    group_add:
      - "44"   # video group for GPU access
      - "104"  # render group for GPU access
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri
      - /dev/kfd:/dev/kfd
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 4096m
          cpus: '4.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8096/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellyseerr - Media Request Management (Overseerr fork for Jellyfin)
  # ==========================================================================
  jellyseerr:
    image: fallenbagel/jellyseerr:2.7.3
    container_name: jellyseerr
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - LOG_LEVEL=info
    ports:
      - "5055:5055"
    volumes:
      - jellyseerr-config:/app/config
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:5055/api/v1/status || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Jellystat - Statistics and Analytics for Jellyfin
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat:
    image: cyfershepard/jellystat:1.1.6
    container_name: jellystat
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_IP=jellystat-db
      - POSTGRES_PORT=5432
      - JWT_SECRET=${JELLYSTAT_JWT_SECRET}
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - jellystat-data:/app/backend/backup-data
    depends_on:
      jellystat-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/api/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Jellystat
  # ==========================================================================
  jellystat-db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: jellystat-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=jellystat
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${JELLYSTAT_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=jellystat
    volumes:
      - jellystat-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U jellystat"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-jellyfin
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  jellyfin-config:
  jellyfin-cache:
  jellyseerr-config:
  jellystat-data:
  jellystat-pgdata:
  portainer_agent_data:

# Document Management Stack
# Paperless-ngx (OCR document management) + Stirling-PDF (PDF utilities)

name: documents

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # Paperless-ngx - Document Management with OCR
  # ==========================================================================
  # Self-hosted document management with full-text search, auto-tagging,
  # and email consumption. All documents are OCR'd for searchability.
  paperless:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:2.20.2
    container_name: paperless
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://paperless-redis:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBHOST=paperless-db
      - PAPERLESS_DBNAME=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBUSER=paperless
      - PAPERLESS_DBPASS=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY=${PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY}
      - PAPERLESS_URL=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev
      # Allow CSRF from both internal and public domains
      - PAPERLESS_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,docs.rambtech.dev,localhost
      - PAPERLESS_CORS_ALLOWED_HOSTS=https://docs.homelab.rambtech.dev,https://docs.rambtech.dev
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      - PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      - PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE=America/New_York
      - PAPERLESS_OCR_LANGUAGE=eng
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_POLLING=60
      - PAPERLESS_CONSUMER_RECURSIVE=true
      - PAPERLESS_TASK_WORKERS=2
      - PAPERLESS_THREADS_PER_WORKER=2
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - paperless-data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - paperless-media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
    depends_on:
      paperless-db:
        condition: service_healthy
      paperless-redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8000/api/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # PostgreSQL - Database for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: paperless-db
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=paperless
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${PAPERLESS_DB_PASSWORD}
      - POSTGRES_DB=paperless
    volumes:
      - paperless-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U paperless"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Redis - Cache/Broker for Paperless-ngx
  # ==========================================================================
  paperless-redis:
    image: redis:8.4-alpine
    container_name: paperless-redis
    volumes:
      - paperless-redis-data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ==========================================================================
  # Stirling-PDF - PDF Manipulation Tools
  # ==========================================================================
  # Comprehensive PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, OCR, convert, etc.
  # Stateless service - no persistent data needed.
  stirling-pdf:
    image: stirlingtools/stirling-pdf:2.1.4
    container_name: stirling-pdf
    environment:
      - DOCKER_ENABLE_SECURITY=false
      - SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN=false
      - SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE=en_US
      - UI_APPNAME=Stirling PDF
      - UI_HOMEDESCRIPTION=PDF tools for the homelab
      - METRICS_ENABLED=false
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    volumes:
      # Training data for better OCR (optional)
      - stirling-tessdata:/usr/share/tessdata
      # Custom configurations
      - stirling-configs:/configs
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 2048m
          cpus: '2.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -f http://localhost:8080/api/v1/info/status || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-documents
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  paperless-data:
  paperless-media:
  paperless-pgdata:
  paperless-redis-data:
  stirling-tessdata:
  stirling-configs:
  portainer_agent_data:

name: authelia

services:
  authelia:
    image: authelia/authelia:4.39.15
    container_name: authelia
    environment:
      TZ: America/New_York
      AUTHELIA_JWT_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/jwt_secret
      AUTHELIA_SESSION_SECRET_FILE: /secrets/session_secret
      AUTHELIA_STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /secrets/storage_encryption_key

      - "9091:9091"
    volumes:
      - ./authelia:/config:ro
      - ./secrets:/secrets:ro
      - authelia-data:/data
    depends_on:
      - redis
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "--quiet", "--tries=1", "--spider", "http://localhost:9091/api/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  redis:
    image: redis:8.4-alpine
    container_name: authelia-redis
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-authelia
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.6
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  authelia-data:
  redis-data:
  portainer_agent_data:

services:
  # ==========================================================================
  # OpenTelemetry Collector - Central telemetry receiver and router
  # ==========================================================================
  otel-collector:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.115.1
    container_name: otel-collector
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol/config.yaml"]
    ports:
      - "4317:4317"   # OTLP gRPC receiver
      - "4318:4318"   # OTLP HTTP receiver
      - "8888:8888"   # Prometheus metrics (collector self-metrics)
      - "8889:8889"   # Prometheus exporter (for scraped metrics)
    volumes:
      - ./otel-collector/config.yaml:/etc/otelcol/config.yaml:ro
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - prometheus
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:13133/ || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # Prometheus - Metrics storage and alerting

    image: prom/prometheus:v3.1.0

      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'

      - '--web.enable-lifecycle'

      start_period: 30s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Uptime Kuma - HTTP endpoint monitoring and status page
  # ==========================================================================
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:1
    container_name: uptime-kuma
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"
    volumes:
      - uptime_kuma_data:/app/data
    dns:
      - 192.168.1.196  # AdGuard DNS for local domain resolution
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1024m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:3001 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 60s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # AutoKuma - Declarative monitor management for Uptime Kuma
  # Monitors defined in ./autokuma/monitors.json
  # ==========================================================================
  autokuma:
    image: ghcr.io/bigboot/autokuma:1.0.0
    container_name: autokuma
    environment:
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__URL=http://uptime-kuma:3001
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__USERNAME=${UPTIME_KUMA_USERNAME:-admin}
      - AUTOKUMA__KUMA__PASSWORD=${UPTIME_KUMA_PASSWORD}
      - AUTOKUMA__STATIC_MONITORS=/monitors/monitors.json
      - AUTOKUMA__DOCKER__ENABLED=false
    volumes:
      - ./autokuma/monitors.json:/monitors/monitors.json:ro
    depends_on:
      - uptime-kuma
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f autokuma || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy - Push notifications
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.11.0
    container_name: ntfy
    command:
      - serve
      - --cache-file=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - --attachment-cache-dir=/var/cache/ntfy/attachments
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./ntfy/server.yml:/etc/ntfy/server.yml:ro
      - ntfy_cache:/var/cache/ntfy
      - ntfy_data:/var/lib/ntfy
    environment:
      - TZ=America/New_York
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "wget -qO- http://localhost:80/v1/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # ntfy-discord-forwarder - Forward ntfy notifications to Discord
  # ==========================================================================
  ntfy-discord-forwarder:
    image: python:3.12-alpine
    container_name: ntfy-discord-forwarder
    command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      - |
        pip install --no-cache-dir requests &&
        python3 -u << 'ENDSCRIPT'
        import requests
        import json
        import os

        NTFY_URL = "http://ntfy:80/homelab-alerts/json"
        DISCORD_WEBHOOK = os.environ["DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL"]

        print(f"Starting ntfy->Discord forwarder. Listening to {NTFY_URL}")
        for line in requests.get(NTFY_URL, stream=True).iter_lines():
            if line:
                data = json.loads(line)
                msg = data.get("message", "")
                if msg:
                    print(f"Forwarding: {msg}")
                    requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK, json={"content": msg})
        ENDSCRIPT
    environment:
      - DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=${DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL}
    depends_on:
      - ntfy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pgrep -f python3 || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped
    labels:
      - "com.centurylinklabs.watchtower.enable=true"

  # ==========================================================================
  # Portainer Edge Agent - Container Management (Outbound Connection)
  # ==========================================================================
  # Edge Agent initiates outbound connection to Portainer (no inbound port exposure)
  # Credentials stored in 1Password: portainer-edge-monitoring
  portainer-edge-agent:
    image: portainer/agent:2.33.5
    container_name: portainer_edge_agent
    environment:
      EDGE: 1
      EDGE_ID: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID}
      EDGE_KEY: ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}
      EDGE_INSECURE_POLL: 1
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - /var/lib/docker/volumes:/var/lib/docker/volumes
      - /:/host
      - portainer_agent_data:/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 128m
          cpus: '0.25'
        reservations:
          memory: 64m
          cpus: '0.25'
    restart: unless-stopped
    # No ports exposed - Edge Agent initiates outbound connection

volumes:
  prometheus_data:
  alertmanager_data:
  grafana_data:
  uptime_kuma_data:
  ntfy_cache:
  ntfy_data:
  portainer_agent_data:

content.text:
The warning is saying that the `model-cache` volume already exists from a previous Docker run (when the container was first created), but it's not marked as `external: true` in the docker-compose.yml. This is actually harmless - Docker Compose just found an existing volume with the same name and is using it.

The warning appears because:
1. The volume `model-cache` was created when the containers first ran
2. Now on subsequent runs, Docker Compose sees this volume already exists
3. Since it's not declared as `external: true`, Docker Compose warns that it didn't create it

This is normal and not a problem - the volume is being reused correctly. It's just a warning to let you know the volume existed before this compose run. The container is working fine with it.

The docker-lxc module's initial deployment uses an Ansible playbook to run `docker compose up -d`, but when we just update the docker-compose.yml file via OpenTofu, there's no automatic restart mechanism.

We have two options to fix this:
1. Manually restart containers after each apply (what we're doing now)
2. The docker-lxc module could be enhanced to trigger a container restart when the docker-compose.yml changes

# =============================================================================
# Docker LXC Module
# =============================================================================
# Opinionated module for deploying Docker-based applications in LXC containers.
# Uses lxc-base + filesync provider + remotedockercompose provider for a
# fully declarative deployment experience.
# =============================================================================

terraform {
  required_providers {
    proxmox = {
      source  = "bpg/proxmox"
      version = "~> 0.69"
    }
    filesync = {
      source  = "darshan-rambhia/filesync"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
    ansible = {
      source  = "marshallford/ansible"
      version = "~> 0.9"
    }
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LXC Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "lxc" {
  source = "../lxc-base"

  name         = var.name
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network - dual-network architecture
  container_ip      = var.container_ip
  container_gateway = var.container_gateway
  lan_ip            = var.lan_ip
  lan_gateway       = var.lan_gateway

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = var.rootfs_storage
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Container type
  unprivileged = var.unprivileged
  template     = var.template

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key               = var.ssh_public_key
  proxmox_ssh_host             = var.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # Features
  enable_nesting = true
  enable_keyctl  = true
  enable_fuse    = false

  # GPU passthrough (AMD Radeon - /dev/kfd, /dev/dri)
  enable_gpu = var.enable_gpu

  # Mount points
  mount_points = var.mount_points

  # Proxmox notes
  description = var.enable_proxmox_notes ? templatefile("${path.module}/templates/notes.md.tftpl", {
    service_name = var.service_name != "" ? var.service_name : var.name
    description  = var.service_description
    urls         = var.service_urls
    services     = var.services
    ssh_host     = split("/", var.container_ip)[0]
    custom_notes = var.custom_notes
    managed_by   = true
  }) : ""

  # Tags
  tags = concat(["docker"], var.tags)
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# File Sync - Using filesync provider directly
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get list of all files in deploy directory, excluding specified patterns
locals {
  _all_deploy_files = var.deploy_dir != "" ? fileset(var.deploy_dir, "**") : []

  # Filter out files matching exclude patterns
  deploy_files = [
    for f in local._all_deploy_files : f
    if !anytrue([for pattern in var.exclude_patterns : can(regex(pattern, f))])
  ]
}

# Sync each file individually using filesync provider
resource "filesync_file" "config_files" {
  for_each = toset(local.deploy_files)

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${each.value}"
  destination = "${var.target_path}/${each.value}"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0644"

  # SSH configuration - provider config is inherited but explicit for clarity
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc]
}

# Set custom permissions for specific files
resource "filesync_file" "custom_permissions" {
  for_each = var.file_permissions

  source      = "${var.deploy_dir}/${trimsuffix(trimprefix(each.key, var.target_path), "/")}"
  destination = each.key
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = each.value

  # SSH configuration
  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [filesync_file.config_files]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Portainer Edge Agent Environment File
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# When Edge credentials are provided, generate a .env file with the credentials.
# Docker Compose automatically loads .env files for variable substitution.
# This allows docker-compose.yml to reference ${PORTAINER_EDGE_ID} and ${PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY}

# First create the file locally (sensitive to avoid logging credentials)
resource "local_sensitive_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  filename = "${path.module}/.generated/${var.name}-portainer-edge.env"
  content  = <<-EOT
# Portainer Edge Agent Credentials
# Auto-generated by OpenTofu - DO NOT EDIT
# Source: 1Password item "portainer-edge-${var.name}"
PORTAINER_EDGE_ID=${var.portainer_edge_id}
PORTAINER_EDGE_KEY=${var.portainer_edge_key}
EOT

  file_permission = "0600"
}

# Then sync to remote container as .env (Docker Compose auto-loads this)
resource "filesync_file" "portainer_edge_env" {
  count = var.portainer_edge_id != "" && var.portainer_edge_key != "" ? 1 : 0

  source      = local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env[0].filename
  destination = "${var.target_path}/.env"
  host        = module.lxc.container_ip
  mode        = "0600"

  ssh_user     = "root"
  ssh_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  depends_on = [module.lxc, local_sensitive_file.portainer_edge_env]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose Deployment via Ansible
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# After filesync completes, Ansible deploys and starts the containers

resource "ansible_navigator_run" "deploy_containers" {
  depends_on = [
    filesync_file.config_files,
    filesync_file.custom_permissions,
    filesync_file.portainer_edge_env
  ]

  triggers = {
    compose_hash = filesha256("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")
    config_hash  = sha256(join(",", [for f in local.deploy_files : filesha256("${var.deploy_dir}/${f}")]))
  }

  execution_environment = {
    enabled = false  # Run ansible directly on host
  }

  ansible_options = {
    private_keys = [{
      name = "homelab"
      data = file(var.ssh_private_key_path)
    }]
  }

  playbook = <<-EOT
    - name: Deploy Docker Compose for ${var.name}
      hosts: lxc
      gather_facts: no
      vars:
        config_dir: ${var.target_path}
        app_name: ${var.name}

      tasks:
        # =====================================================================
        # Verify Required Files
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Check docker-compose.yml exists
          ansible.builtin.stat:
            path: "{{ config_dir }}/docker-compose.yml"
          register: compose_file

        - name: Fail if docker-compose.yml missing
          ansible.builtin.fail:
            msg: "Required file missing: docker-compose.yml"
          when: not compose_file.stat.exists

        # =====================================================================
        # Pull Images & Start Containers
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Pull container images
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: docker compose -f {{ config_dir }}/docker-compose.yml pull
            chdir: "{{ config_dir }}"
          register: pull_result
          changed_when: "'Pulled' in pull_result.stdout or 'Downloaded' in pull_result.stdout"

        - name: Start containers
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: docker compose -f {{ config_dir }}/docker-compose.yml up -d --remove-orphans
            chdir: "{{ config_dir }}"
          register: up_result
          changed_when: "'Started' in up_result.stderr or 'Creating' in up_result.stderr or 'Created' in up_result.stderr"

        # =====================================================================
        # Health Checks
        # =====================================================================
        - name: Wait for containers to stabilize
          ansible.builtin.pause:
            seconds: 10

        - name: Get container status
          ansible.builtin.command:
            cmd: docker compose -f {{ config_dir }}/docker-compose.yml ps --format json
            chdir: "{{ config_dir }}"
          register: ps_result
          changed_when: false

        - name: Verify all containers are running
          ansible.builtin.assert:
            that:
              - ps_result.stdout | length > 0
            fail_msg: "No containers found for {{ app_name }}"
            success_msg: "Containers deployed successfully for {{ app_name }}"
  EOT

  inventory = yamlencode({
    lxc = {
      hosts = {
        "${var.name}" = {
          ansible_host = module.lxc.container_ip
          ansible_user = "root"
        }
      }
    }
  })
}

I found the issue! Looking at [main.tf:176-270](tofu/modules/docker-lxc/main.tf#L176-L270), the `ansible_navigator_run` resource has a `triggers` block that should cause it to re-run when files change:

```hcl
triggers = {
  compose_hash = filesha256("${var.deploy_dir}/docker-compose.yml")
  config_hash  = sha256(join(",", [for f in local.deploy_files : filesha256("${var.deploy_dir}/${f}")]))
}
```

This means when `docker-compose.yml` changes, Ansible should automatically restart containers. However, the issue is that when I ran `task tofu:apply`, the Ansible playbook likely ran but I didn't see clear output indicating containers were restarted.

Let me check the apply output from Immich more carefully:

The `triggers` attribute allows you to "Trigger various behaviors via arbitrary values." This is part of the `ansible_navigator_run` resource which runs an Ansible playbook and requires ansible-navigator and a container engine to run within an execution environment (EE).

The **marshallford/ansible provider** for Terraform enables you to:
- Run Ansible playbooks using Terraform
- Control playbook re-run behavior using several "lifecycle" options, including an attribute for running the playbook on resource destruction
- Implement conditional tasks with the environment variable ANSIBLE_TF_OPERATION and access the previous run's inventory via the ANSIBLE_TF_PREVIOUS_INVENTORY environment variable

The triggers attribute functions similarly to Terraform's null_resource triggers, allowing you to specify when the Ansible playbook should be re-executed based on changes to arbitrary values. This is useful for forcing re-runs when specific dependencies change.

The provider documentation is available on the Terraform Registry at registry.terraform.io/providers/marshallford/ansible, and the latest version was published June 13, 2025.
